title: PRESS BRIEF
subtitle: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE. OFFICE SCALE. INCLINE PRESS. QUIET CORE. OWN THE WOBBLE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. TUESDAY. PRESS BRIEF. FIFTEEN MINUTES. PUSH AND CORE. WE PRESS CLEAN. WE BRACE QUIET. NO HIDING BEHIND THE KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. PRESS BRIEF DONE. CHEST WORKED. CORE QUIET. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON A STURDY CHAIR OR STAIR. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE EDGE. FULL LOCKOUT. KNEES DOWN LEGAL IF FORM BREAKS.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS ON THE INCLINE. TWO SETS OF SIX. HANDS ON THE CHAIR OR STAIR. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE EDGE. KNEES DOWN IF YOU NEED THEM. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A WET SANDWICH.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. DO NOT CHECK YOUR EMAIL.

exercises.name: STANDING SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: ARMS FORWARD, PINCH SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. SLOW AND CLEAN.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PINCH THE BLADES BACK AND DOWN. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. FIX THE DESK HUNCH. NO SHRUGS, YOU SLOPPY BUGGER.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON PARADE.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. SLOW OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. RIBS DOWN. NO RUSH.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. SLOW. CORE QUIET. RIBS DOWN. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BACK QUIET.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK (KNEES)
exercises.cue: ON THE FOREARM. KNEES DOWN LEGAL. HIPS UP. STACK THE SHOULDERS. TEN SECONDS ONLY. BUILD SLOW.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK ON THE KNEES. TWO SETS. TEN SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM DOWN. HIPS UP. TEN SECONDS ONLY. DO NOT PLAY HERO AND QUIT TOMORROW.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH WHEN I SAY.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS COMPLETE. THAT IS THE LOT.
